(Currently Amended) Claim 1: An apparatus, comprising: an encoder (300) for encoding mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to encode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures, wherein the mode mapping information is __adapted based on__ one or more actual parameters of the sequence.

(Currently Amended) Claim 7: The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the adapted mode mapping information is updated after encoding one or more pictures of the sequence __based on updated actual parameters__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 9: A method, comprising: encoding (740, 970) mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to encode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures, wherein the mode mapping information is __adapted based on__ one or more actual parameters of the sequence (740, 940, 960).

(Currently Amended) Claim 25: A method, comprising: decoding (820, 1030) mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to decode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures, wherein the mode mapping information is __adapted based on__ one or more actual parameters of the sequence.

(Currently Amended) Claim 33: A non-transitory computer-readable storage medium having video signal data encoded thereupon, comprising: mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to encode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures, wherein the mode mapping information is __adapted based on__ one or more actual parameters of the sequence.
